source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 30 attended and 180 machine minutes; unique row/variant.

old_problem: Neither the tool family nor a visible Gen6 selector proves end-to-end Gen6 support. This row also needs a Gen3 start in every cycle, so another Gen6 case or one final high-speed state cannot satisfy it.
disposition_reason: The source establishes an auditable 500-cycle Gen3-to-Gen6 objective and oracle. Platform capability, vendor primitive, topology, timing/error limits and recovery are runtime bindings. Requiring a positive full-path Gen6 certificate and fail-closed Gen3-start ledger resolves review semantics without forcing unsupported hardware.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2113, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2114 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00035-V002 / e4797526331da453 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Speed Change 36 specifically preserves 500 Gen3-to-Gen6 transitions at expected width/speed with no errors; Gen1/Gen2-origin results cannot replace it.
Require affirmative Gen6/full-width support for root port, switch, retimer, board/backplane, endpoint/GPU, firmware and pinned LTSSM/NVQual primitive before action.
Each cycle must independently prove Gen3/full-width entry, then record Gen6 request, equalization/LTSSM, settle deadline, final width/speed, enumeration and fresh error/health deltas.
If any component lacks support, keep execution BLOCKED; N/A is allowed only with authoritative SPEC. Do not force or downgrade.

Count only 500 durable chronological transactions and stop before the next request on unsupported mode, invalid start, failed/late/downtrained Gen6, device loss, disqualifying error/reset or artifact gap.
Preserve the first anomaly and use only signed recovery; no log clearing or automatic retry.
No capability probe, LTSSM/NVQual, speed force/change, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.purpose: Qualify five hundred genuine full-width Gen3-to-Gen6 transitions on the mapped GB-NV-PVP path after authoritative end-to-end Gen6 capability proof.
required_package: Authoritative Gen6/full-width support matrix for the complete path and firmware
Pinned NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 36 build, command and configuration
Approved Gen3 entry, Gen6 equalization/LTSSM/settle/error and exact 500-count rules
Dedicated SUT, durable ledger/interlock, stable power/cooling, console and recovery
test_case.test_command: DO NOT FORCE OR EXECUTE until Project Configuration certifies complete Gen6/full-width support and binds Speed Change 36. After point approval preserve baselines and execute entries 1..500, proving Gen3/full width before each request and recording Gen6 request, equalization/LTSSM, settled speed/width, enumeration, errors and health before the next entry. Stop on first unsupported state, fault or gap; do not clear, downgrade or retry.
test_case.expected_result: With capability proven, all 500 entries independently show full-width Gen3 start and Gen6 settle within the signed envelope, required devices present, no disqualifying new PCIe/GPU/host/BMC/thermal/power error and approved final health. Without capability, execution remains BLOCKED.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until positive Gen6 capability, tool/path, Gen3-start method and limits are approved. PASS then requires 500 complete accepted Gen3-to-Gen6 records. FAIL on force/mismatch, invalid start, failed/late/downtrained/reduced target, device loss, disqualifying error/reset or recovery failure. Missing capability/input/artifact is BLOCKED; N/A needs authoritative SPEC.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED without component-by-component Gen6/full-width proof.
Never infer capability from a tool option or substitute a lower generation/width.
Use only the approved primitive on an isolated SUT with console, stable power/cooling and point authorization.
Preserve first-fault evidence and stop without automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and positive Gen6 capability matrix
Pinned Speed Change 36 tool/configuration and complete topology/lane/firmware map
Per-cycle Gen3-start plus Gen6 equalization/full-width/deadline/error contract and baseline
Ledger 1..500 with raw start, request, LTSSM/equalization, settled Gen6/width, enumeration, timestamps and result
Per-cycle AER/kernel/GPU/BMC/thermal/power correlation and completeness audit
First-fault/recovery or clean final state, no-force/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On unsupported indication, invalid Gen3 entry, failed/late/downtrained Gen6, device loss, disqualifying error/reset or artifact gap, inhibit all later requests and preserve the first event. Do not force, downgrade or retry; follow signed recovery and quarantine if topology/health is not restored.
